project_name: 2. S-Bahn-Stammstrecke Laim–Leuchtenbergring with start operating concept
note: Existing S-Bahn station, rebuilt as the western changeover station (4 tracks). Line: Freising/Flughafen–Laim–Marienhof–Leuchtenbergring–Ebersberg, every 15 min (30 min on the Freising and Flughafen branches north of Neufahrn). The station list is verified on 2.stammstrecke-muenchen.de. The line table is the 2017 start concept (Mitfall 6+) from German Wikipedia, consistent with Landtag 17/7917 (S1 and S6 on the 2nd trunk, every 15 min all day) and the BEG second operating stage (express to Mammendorf, Herrsching, Ebersberg and the airport every 30 min). It is not a final timetable. Peak equals off-peak because the concept is 'ganztägig' and no peak extras are published. Lines are re-routed, not added, so remove the old routings of S1 and S6 in the model.
